out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed greens (52F), seafood pancakes (54F), raw salmon (55F) in 2 door prep at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. All items discarded.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: observed sushi rice without end point marking.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC added end point marking.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed vacuum packaged yellow tail tuna thawing in 2 door flat without first being removed from package.
violations.corrective_action: PIC cut package open during inspection.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Observed cockroach on wall near dish machine and non-food contact surface of exterior gasket of 2 door prep.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Please contact pest control and submit invoice to EHS within 10 days. Please also ensure any recommendations made by pest control technician to eliminate issue are followed.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: observed 2 door prep at 60F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC discarded all TCS foods stored in unit overnight. Foods prepared within the past 4 hours of inspection relocated to alternate, working unit to be cooled down to 41F or below within a remainder of 2 hours. Please contact technician for repair and submit invoice to EHS within 10 days.

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The door gaskets of the following unit(s) are damaged: 2 door prep at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. Please repair/replace gasket.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: stoves at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Please clean surfaces of stove. MANEKI NEKO JAPANESE RESTAURAN (Inspection Date: 06/11/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floors, walls, and ceilings are in need of cleaning. Observed food and debris near floor drains, dust along walls and ceilings.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Please conduct a deep clean of the establishment by follow up inspection.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed employee touch face and attempt to prepare food without first washing hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. PIC trained employee on proper hand washing. Employee washed hands.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: observed employee touch ready to eat lettuce with bare hands.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. Employee discarded lettuce and applied gloves.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the kitchen being used to store a water bottle and 2 strainers.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Employees removed items from sink. EHS conducted education regarding proper hand sink use.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no paper towels at hand sink in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Employee provided paper towels at hand sink. MANEKI NEKO JAPANESE RESTAURAN (Inspection Date: 12/17/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw shrimp over ready to eat sauce in 2 door prep; raw chicken over ready to eat dressing in 2 door upright.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC rearranged units to store raw items below ready to eat foods.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: observed no end point marking for sushi rice at sushi bar.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC provided end point marking.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: observed frozen soups thawing at ambient in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS conducted education regarding proper thawing procedures. Employee placed frozen items under refrigeration to properly thaw.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Dead or trapped pests were found on the premises. Observed sticky traps with dead cockroaches in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. PIC discarded sticky traps.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wiping cloths stored on counter in kitchen. Observed wet wiping cloths near sushi bar stored in <10 PPM of chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS conducted education regarding proper wet wiping usage. Employee made sanitizer solution with 50 PPM of chlorine to properly store wet wiping cloths. Please use test strips to ensure chlorine is at an appropriate chlorine concentration of 50-100 PPM.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed tongs at cook line stored in ambient water, deli container used as scoop stored in (uncooked) rice bin.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed tongs to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized and removed deli container from rice container.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees washing hands with dirty gloves donned and without the use of soap.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. PIC trained all staff on proper hand washing procedures. All staff properly washed hands before returning to preparatory tasks.

violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces.
